posts.zh:
dsh-ui-tweaks 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

posts.en:
dsh-ui-tweaks is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7f5b71967d5c6ae5b0a6.html
